Found by the memev twin on 30 October 2026 at main be457db (a sealed run in the twin's evidence). Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: SR-1.01, QL-1.02. tasks.title: Unrebuildable notes are counted and surfaced
requirements: recover() records every path it cannot rebuild with the reason (content hash mismatch, record unreadable) instead of continuing silently
status() reports unrecoverable with the paths, and memev doctor has an oplog check that fails naming them
DESIGN.md and THREAT-MODEL.md say what is rebuilt and what is reported

criteria.statement: A note whose logged content was altered with its record hash recomputed and whose file was removed is listed by status() as unrecoverable and fails the doctor's oplog check
The design page states the reported case
No mutant of the changed lines survives this task's test (QL-1.02)
